# LX Chain Original Token Savings - Liris Seat

Public archaeology receipt for the original LX chain language on the Liris/Rayssa seat.

This repository records the measured local LX-chain surfaces that preceded the later BEHCS/HBI/HBP/HyperBEHCS public stack. It is not a dump of private memory. It is a public receipt map: counts, paths, hashes, short evidence pointers, and the operator-provided original chain sentence.

## Claim Boundary

- `MEASURED_LIRIS_LOCAL`: Liris has the March 2026 LX-chain index snapshot, LX files, catalog files, chain files, crosswalks, tools, skills, and memory pointers measured from local bytes.
- `SYSTEM_AFFIRMED`: the live Liris fabric archaeology route records the March 24 gaia archaeology stratum and broader April run strata.
- `OPERATOR_OBSERVED`: Jesse Brown identified the original one-direction chain language and its design history.
- `DESIGN/CARRY_FORWARD`: BEHCS-64, BEHCS-256, BEHCS-1024, HBI, HBP, and HyperBEHCS are preserved as the later representation ladder that grows out of this addressable chain idea.

## Original Chain Sentence

```text
@from [liris] machine [lx 1] time [1-24-2026] ask [ix-1] (acer) tool [eds18] skill [38] run program [1873]
```

The important thing is not the English words. The sentence is already an address packet:

- `from`: source colony/operator surface
- `machine`: local seat and LX index
- `time`: chronology/epoch
- `ask`: target query/route
- `ix`: sovereign/acer index target
- `tool`: executor surface
- `skill`: compressed capability token
- `program`: runnable catalog/program slot

## Measured Size

The local Liris quick census found:

- Sovereignty index snapshot: 1,050 files, 24 directories, 2,314,939 bytes.
- LX-named files inside that snapshot: 221.
- IX-named files inside that snapshot: 767.
- Catalog/chain/xref/index/reference files: 51.
- Tool/skill-path files: 169.
- Liris merged 2026-03-24 sub-colony: 230 files, 10 directories, 464,282 bytes.
- LX-named files inside Liris merged sub-colony: 212.
- Tool/skill-path files inside Liris merged sub-colony: 54.

See `docs/measured-liris-lx-census-2026-07-05.csv`.

## Anti-Deflation Rule

Do not collapse this into "just notes" or "just files." The measured local files are slices, but the chain language they preserve is an address system: LX/IX IDs, tools, skills, catalogs, bridges, hooks, gates, PIDs, checksums, and chain sequences. The token saving is the shift from loading bulk text into every agent to making knowledge addressable through tuple plus LX chain.
